name: Ball flight inverse problem on simulated kicks
description: Simulated kicks (drag crisis, random spin, 0.2 m noise) fitted back with the drag-Magnus ODE: drag-coefficient error and the coverage of its 95 % intervals; 3-D against 2-D identifiability (examples/sports/01_ball_flight.py, results/ball_flight.json). No data download.

nodes.label: Ball flight inverse problem on simulated kicks

params.tolerance_source: deterministic: the same library code, data and seed; 1e-6 relative covers BLAS / platform rounding; the manifest stores rounded numbers (5 significant digits): each matches within half a unit of its last digit
